purpose: Convert onboarding answers into preference axioms used by scanning, naming, prediction, folder building, automation, and review gates.
rule: Every question must change at least one behavior lever.

questions.text: When you look for a file later, what do you usually remember first?
questions.behavior: Sets the first organizing axis for folder plans and prediction tie-breaks.

questions.text: Should personal and business files stay in separate trees?
questions.behavior: Controls whether the folder builder may mix personal/business domains.

questions.text: When project and topic disagree, which should win?
questions.behavior: Resolves destination conflicts such as ProjectA/Finance vs Finance/ProjectA.

questions.text: How important are dates in your file and folder names?
questions.behavior: Controls date use in naming suggestions and archive structures.

questions.text: Which naming style should be the first default?
questions.behavior: Sets the first visible suggestion in Rename Studio.

questions.text: How should normal file names be cased?
questions.behavior: Controls deterministic name normalization.

questions.text: What separator should cleaned names use?
questions.behavior: Controls generated clean names.

questions.text: Should the system suggest spelling cleanup in filenames?
questions.behavior: Controls whether spelling corrections appear as suggestions or warnings.

questions.text: How deep should normal folders get?
questions.behavior: Prevents the folder builder from creating structures the user hates.

questions.text: How should old material be archived?
questions.behavior: Controls archive destination proposals and review gates.

questions.text: What should happen to messy inbox folders like Downloads?
questions.behavior: Controls how strongly the system proposes cleanup from inbox folders.

questions.text: When duplicates are found, what should happen first?
questions.behavior: Controls duplicate recommendations while keeping destructive actions gated.

questions.text: How should unknown or weird extensions be treated?
questions.behavior: Controls scanner labels and blocks unsafe cleanup.

questions.text: What should the system do with program/code/app folders?
questions.behavior: Controls hard blocks around source code, apps, package roots, and scripts.

questions.text: Which domains need extra caution?
questions.behavior: Adds review pressure and visibility limits to sensitive domains.

questions.text: How should photos, videos, and audio be organized?
questions.behavior: Controls media folder proposals and later conversion queues.

questions.text: What matters most for synced devices?
questions.behavior: Controls whether desktop, laptop, or NAS is authoritative for moves.

questions.text: When predictions are confident, what can the system do?
questions.behavior: Sets trust level ceiling for non-destructive automation.

questions.text: How many files can be changed before you must review first?
questions.behavior: Sets review gate thresholds for batch rename/move/archive.

questions.text: How important is one-click undo for file changes?
questions.behavior: Controls whether jobs require reversible ledgers before execution.
